description: Download an attachment from the user's Caliu storage so you can view or process it. Accepts the attachment id or the full download URL found in note markdown (https://.../attachments/<id>/download). Images come back as viewable image content, text-based files (txt, md, csv, json, svg, ...) as text, audio as audio content, and other binaries as a base64 resource. Refuses files over 10MB.

attachmentId.description: The attachment id, or the full .../attachments/<id>/download URL from note markdown.

name: get_attachment

contentType.description: Media type with any charset parameter stripped.

filename.description: From the Content-Disposition header, when the server sent one.
